title: Analysis: Elon Musk contributed a record $474M to political groups for the 2026 midterms, including $216M to America PAC, the highest non-candidate spend ever (Theodore Schleifer/New York Times)
summary: Theodore Schleifer / New York Times: Analysis: Elon Musk contributed a record $474M to political groups for the 2026 midterms, including $216M to America PAC, the highest non-candidate spend ever — Never before has a single ultrawealthy person who was not running for office spent this much during a single election cycle.
